recent_en: KGROUP announced a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) on 21 November 2026 and released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2025 on the same day. The company held its 23rd Annual General Meeting on 28 August 2026, where all resolutions were passed. Between September and October 2026, several directors had changes in various committee roles.
notable_en: Announced a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) on 21 November 2026.
Held its 23rd Annual General Meeting on 28 August 2026; all resolutions were passed.
Between September and October 2026, several directors had changes in nomination, remuneration, risk, and audit committee roles.
